Explore in 3D.

Drag to rotate the camera. Inspect the top, walls, or underside. Each block is a cube. Height shows escape time; the Mandelbrot set remains two-dimensional.

Camera movement does not change the fractal location. Arrow keys pan the fractal. Adaptive mode uses fewer cubes during movement, then restores the full view. Press C if the terrain leaves the view.
